title: Better Than Nothing
description: An in-between challenge and fun survival experience to spice up the game.
body:
![Better than Nothing logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5db33606d53c3c3197fb62f6f30d5a98454a0b7f.png)

A fun survival challenge, between being fun and unforgivably painful at times.

I made this as a successor to my modpack, _Vanilla: Remixed_, and my not so forgiving modpack, _Pain o' Plenty_. I found that Pain o' Plenty was way too difficult, even for me, so I wanted to make a modpack that would be fun, but not compromise the idea of making a difficult modpack at the same time.

This modpack contains:
- Tide 2, a fishing mod.
- Improved farming with Farmer's Delight & Brewin' and Chewin', so you can contribute to alcoholism! (please don't do this in real life)
- Overhauled trees with Dynamic Trees.
- NEW BIRDS! (Foul Play Mod)
- More storage with Sophisticated Backpacks. Why isn't this already in the game?

And for the difficulty mods:
- No more sitting on stonecutters with Danger Close mod.
- NO MORE COORDINATES WITH F3. GET A COMPASS.
- Like it when Hell just spreads into your world? Same. You'll get that with the Nether Portal Spread mod.
- Contribute to your arachnophobia with the Nyf's Spiders mod!
- Completely redesign the ore progression of the game with the Overgeared mod.
- Last but not least, Tough as Nails for temperature. Because I hate you, that's why.

-SoulfulCorvus 2026
